commentary.text: 90+6' Unsportsmanlike conduct. Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is shown a red card off the pitch!
90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
90+3' A cross by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) replaces Nico Williams.
89' Substitution. Inaki Williams did his best and is replaced by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao).
88' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

85' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Vicente Guaita makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom left corner.
82' Ernesto Valverde has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) replacing Alex Berenguer.
82' Here comes a substitution. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) is brought on as a substitute for Unai Gomez.
82' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
82' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
79' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
77' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
76' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Celta Vigo have a corner.
74' 1 - 2 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:2.
73' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Unai Simon comes off the line to clear the ball away.
71' 0 - 2 Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
70' Today's match ends for Borja Iglesias who will be replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Javier Rodriguez will be replaced by Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo).
68' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Vicente Guaita anticipates well and smothers the ball.
67' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta and he is replaced by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
65' A mistake by a defender gifts Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes well wide of the left post.
63' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' Fran Beltran will be replaced by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo).
62' 0 - 1 Inaki Williams provides Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
59' Having seen unsporting behavior, Miguel Ortiz shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is the recipient.
59' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
58' Vicente Guaita is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao). Easy save!
55' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
54' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Ath Bilbao.
52' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball in, but Vicente Guaita comfortably gathers the ball.
51' A clumsy foul by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle.

48' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
46' Claudio Giraldez has made a change at the break. Oscar Mingueza has come on in place of Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo).
46' Half-time substitution. Claudio Giraldez decided to make a change. Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is replaced by Hugo Alvarez.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45' Miguel Ortiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
43' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) sends a chip pass into the box, but Unai Simon is quickest to intercept the ball.
41' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
37' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

36' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) sends a rebound goalwards towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it. The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.
36' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
34' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
33' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo). Miguel Ortiz saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
31' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
30' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.
29' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

25' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is inside the box in a promising position to head home! His poor header flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was! The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
23' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
20' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
17' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

16' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Vicente Guaita thwarts him with a nice save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
15' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
14' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
12' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
11' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
9' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
5' Good defending. Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) tries to find Borja Iglesias inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
4' Ath Bilbao take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
2' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) passes the ball onto Alex Berenguer, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Today's referee will be Miguel Ortiz.
